crossrefs.text: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
When they continued to question Him, He straightened up and said to them, “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her.”
When they heard this, they began to go away one by one, beginning with the older ones, until only Jesus was left, with the woman standing there.
Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
you, then, who teach others, do you not teach yourself? You who preach against stealing, do you steal?
You who boast in the law, do you dishonor God by breaking the law?
Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
Then Peter began to speak: “I now truly understand that God does not show favoritism,
For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe.
and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.
the One great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes are on all the ways of the sons of men, to reward each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds.
And now, may the fear of the LORD be upon you. Be careful what you do, for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.”
But as for the highly esteemed—whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism—those leaders added nothing to me.
Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.
For God will bring every deed into judgment, along with every hidden thing, whether good or evil.

Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of menʼs hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.
Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent them off on another route?
Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.
For what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them.
And wherever they went among the nations, they profaned My holy name, because it was said of them, ‘These are the people of the LORD, yet they had to leave His land.’

I will show the holiness of My great name, which has been profaned among the nations—the name you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, declares the Lord GOD, when I show My holiness in you before their eyes.
And now what have I here? declares the LORD. For My people have been taken without cause; those who rule them taunt, declares the LORD, and My name is blasphemed continually all day long.
No, I discipline my body and make it my slave, so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified.
Many will follow in their depravity, and because of them the way of truth will be defamed.
So practice and observe everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.
In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.

Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets practice divination for money. Yet they lean upon the LORD, saying, “Is not the LORD among us? No disaster can come upon us.”

notes.title: God's name blasphemed among the Gentiles

crossrefs.text: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, and you will love Him with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.
For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—
Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and stiffen your necks no more.
In Him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of your sinful nature, with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands.
And having been buried with Him in baptism, you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God, who raised Him from the dead.

Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and remove the foreskins of your hearts, O men of Judah and people of Jerusalem. Otherwise, My wrath will break out like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it, because of your evil deeds.”
For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What counts is a new creation.
Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
